entities.summary: Guadalupe Nettel is a Mexican writer. She has published four novels, including The Body Where I Was Born (2011), After the Winter (2014) and Still Born (2023), which was shortlisted for the International Booker Prize, as well as three short story collections. She is a recipient of numerous international awards. She has contributed to Granta, El País, The New York Times, The Yale Review, The White Review, La Repubblica and La Stampa. Her works have been translated into more than 20 languages and adapted for film and theater.
